title: Recovering a GAP Benefit Overpaid on Add-On Refunds
content:
# Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda — Recovery of a GAP Benefit Overpaid on Add-On Refunds

**Scope.** This entry governs the reversal of the overpaid part of a paid GAP balance line under the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda. It applies where the holder's Kessler Shield service contract or Kessler Care maintenance plan, financed on the same purchase deal as the waiver, was cancelled with its refund paid to the lienholder. A reopened or withdrawn insurer settlement and a recovered stolen vehicle are outside this entry.

**Effect.** For a paid GAP balance line reversed under this entry, the benefit counts as paid in error to the extent of the add-on overpayment reversal, and no further. The reversal is one benefit reversal entry pointing at the paid line, for the add-on overpayment reversal rather than for the full line. It is dated on the day it is booked and carries the paid line's claim number. The waiver's benefits paid fall by the amount reversed. The waiver's status does not change. The holder can see the reversal on the waiver's claim history.

## Invocation: `recover_benefit_overpayment_99b30941`

The agent unlocks the agent-side tool `recover_benefit_overpayment_99b30941` and then calls it.

- `gap_waiver_id`: reference number of the GAP waiver whose paid line is reversed, as returned by the GAP waiver lookup. Id format.
- `source_entry_id`: reference number of the paid GAP balance line being reversed, as shown on the waiver's ledger lookup. Id format.
- `amount`: the part of the paid line reversed, in USD. A positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent (a half cent goes up).

**Successful receipt.** "Benefit reversal booked: entry <entry id> for <amount> USD against paid line <source_entry_id> on claim <claim number> under waiver <gap_waiver_id>; benefits paid now <total> USD." Here <entry id> is the new reversal entry's reference number, <amount> is the reversed amount with 2 decimals, and <total> is the waiver's benefits paid net of the reversal with 2 decimals. Receiving this line means the reversal is recorded.

**Refusal.** The source reference must name a paid GAP balance line of this same waiver, and the amount must be above 0.00. Otherwise the tool returns a line starting "Error:" and writes nothing.

### Quick reference

| Question | Answer from this entry |
|---|---|
| Which line is reversed? | A paid GAP balance line of the waiver, named by its reference number |
| Does the waiver reopen? | No. Its status is left unchanged. |
| Is the full line reversed? | No. Only the add-on overpayment reversal is reversed. |
